sources.name: TCGA diagnostic and tissue slides

literature_estimate.slides: approximately 12,000 diagnostic FFPE slides; substantially more if tissue/frozen slides are included
literature_estimate.raw_storage: typically 10-25 TiB for a diagnostic-scale acquisition; obtain the exact live total with discover-gdc

sources.notes: Best first source: multi-organ, open access, stable API, exact byte sizes and checksums. Keep diagnostic slides as the default to reduce frozen-section/domain confounding.

sources.name: CPTAC pathology collections mirrored in NCI Imaging Data Commons

literature_estimate.slides: approximately 5,000-7,200 WSIs depending on release/cohort inclusion
literature_estimate.raw_storage: multi-TiB; use list-idc and discover-idc for current collection-level totals

sources.notes: Use list-idc first because IDC collection identifiers and releases evolve. idc-index estimates and downloads directly from public cloud buckets without credentials.

sources.name: All public NCI IDC Slide Microscopy collections
sources.notes: Run list-idc to obtain a live inventory. Review collection licenses and avoid benchmark leakage before adding a collection to pretraining.

sources.name: GTEx histology images
sources.access: open viewer and metadata; bulk image access is not exposed by the public histology metadata API

literature_estimate.raw_storage: not reliably estimable through the public metadata service

sources.notes: Do not scrape the viewer. Treat GTEx as a candidate requiring an approved bulk-access route from the data provider; the script intentionally does not automate image scraping.
